senses.gloss:
Sṛmara is the name of an unknown animal at the Aśvamedha
(‘horse sacrifice’) in the Yajurveda Saṃhitās.^1
1) Taittirīya Saṃhita, v. 5, 16, 1
(according to Sāyaṇa = camara); Maitrā-
yaṇī Saṃhitā, iii. 14, 20; Vājasaneyi
Saṃhitā, xxiv. 39 (where Mahīdhara
identifies it with the Gavaya).
